releasesInRange.body:
## New Features

- Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429)
- Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)
- Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273)
- Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)
- Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)
- Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)

## Bug Fixes

- Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
- The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)
- Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)
- On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)
- Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
- `codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)

## Documentation

- Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
- Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)

## Chores

- Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
- Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

## Changelog

Full Changelog: https://github.com/openai/codex/compare/rust-v0.162.0...rust-v0.163.0

- #51539 Add completion-aware realtime attachment and session-scoped detach @zahan-oai
- #51547 Add a Windows MXC sandbox opt-out @iceweasel-oai
- #51556 Complete dynamic tool lifecycles on cancellation @mikelam-oai
- #51575 Expose package assembly helpers and support gzip DotSlash artifacts @bolinfest

prs.title: Support daemon installation from Windows WinGet packages
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Support daemon installation from Windows WinGet packages

## Why

WinGet archives place the CLI and code mode host at the package root, while daemon installation expects them under `bin/`. This layout mismatch prevents installing the daemon from a WinGet CLI package.

## What changed

Validate WinGet packages in their original layout before converting the staged copy to the daemon layout. Move the executables under `bin/`, update the package entrypoint and optional voice manifest checksum key, and hash the final tree for release reuse. Leave the source package unchanged.

## Testing

Add a Windows integration test covering daemon startup, repeated `update --from-cli --yes` calls, rewritten manifests, and rejection of an incomplete package without changing the selected release or source manifests.

prs.title: Reject Guardian review threads during interactive CLI resume
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Reject Guardian review threads during interactive CLI resume

## What changed

Check the selected thread's app-server metadata before resuming it in the TUI. Reject Guardian review threads with a clear error and suggest `codex resume <parent_thread_id>` when a parent session is available. Preserve existing resume behavior if the metadata read fails.

## Testing

Add a regression test for Guardian thread rejection and the parent-session hint. Update daemon startup coverage to select a saved session when testing `resume`.

prs.title: Prune unused app-server daemon releases safely
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Prune unused app-server daemon releases safely

## What changed

- Record the current and previous dedicated daemon selections in `selection-history`, bound to the selection link's identity. Preserve that history when an install leaves the selection unchanged.
- Prune unused releases after package preparation and scheduled update processing, including updates that require no restart. Retain the current and previous selections, packages used by the daemon or updater, and the calling executable's package.
- Require lifecycle and installer locks, valid selection history, and verified package boundaries before cleanup. Skip unsafe or unrecognized packages and retire releases before best-effort deletion so partial failures are not retried.
- Resolve the updater's actual executable identity after an executable handoff that preserves its PID.

## Testing

Extend coverage for stale selection history, retention of the last two selections, packages containing external symlinks, partial deletion and reinstall, cleanup without restarting the daemon, and repeated installs preserving selection history.

prs.title: Track content provenance through prompt assembly and compaction
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Track content provenance through prompt assembly and compaction

## Why

Message roles and content classifications do not identify who supplied each context part. Source attribution needs to survive prompt assembly and history truncation, including messages that combine text from different producers.

## What changed

- Add per-part `ContentItemMetadata` for user input, developer instructions, `AGENTS.md`, skills, harness context, command hooks, and tool context with optional callable namespaces.
- Carry attribution alongside content and classifications through contextual fragments, extension prompts, hook output, and agent messages. Keep tool-provided context-window hints separate from harness text.
- Preserve the source of retained text slices during compaction and attribute generated truncation notices to the harness. Default missing historical attribution to unknown.
- Attribute host MCP calls using cached tool namespaces only when catalog revisions remain stable, without starting servers or refreshing catalogs for attribution.
- Send the new metadata to Responses Lite and strip it from requests to endpoints that do not support it.

## Testing

Extend compaction tests to cover mixed sources, missing or extra metadata entries, and discarded media. Update Responses Lite request assertions to verify endpoint-specific attribution handling.

prs.title: Fix daemon updater socket binding and bootstrap readiness on Unix
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix daemon updater socket binding and bootstrap readiness on Unix

## Why

The updater bound its socket directly beneath `CODEX_HOME`, which can exceed Unix socket path limits. Bootstrap could also report success before the updater's manual-update socket was ready.

## What changed

- Reuse the control socket's protected binding and cleanup guard for the updater, with a symlink at the advertised socket path.
- Remove stale updater socket entries before startup while preserving regular files.
- Wait up to 30 seconds for supported automatic updaters to publish their socket, without connecting as a readiness probe. Report updater exit or timeout with stderr log context.
- Preserve compatibility with older updaters that lack the manual-update command.

## Testing

Add Unix integration tests for updater readiness with a long `CODEX_HOME` path and bootstrap failure when a regular file blocks the updater socket, verifying that the file is preserved and the daemon remains running.

prs.title: Reuse staged file digests when preparing daemon installs
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Reuse staged file digests when preparing daemon installs

## Why

Daemon installation rereads staged files to verify the executable and hash the normalized WinGet package, even though staging already computed their digests.

## What changed

Cache file digests while copying the package and reuse them for the staged executable comparison and final WinGet tree hash. Update cached paths when moving WinGet executables and refresh digests when rewriting manifests.

Continue hashing source packages and existing releases from disk so digest reuse does not bypass content validation.

## Testing

Extend the installation test to corrupt an existing release's `codex-package.json` and verify that reinstalling rejects it while preserving the current selection.

prs.title: Record bucketed terminal sizes in TUI telemetry
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Record bucketed terminal sizes in TUI telemetry

## What changed

- Add `terminal_columns` and `terminal_rows` buckets to `codex.tui.start`.
- Record `codex.tui.terminal_size` for new turns in the active thread and for resize bucket changes after the terminal size settles for 15 seconds. Reuse launch context and suppress duplicate turn notifications.
- Respect analytics consent for the built-in metrics exporter while allowing explicitly configured OTLP collectors. Apply consent checks to the active exporter across provider replacements.

## Testing

Add coverage for exporter replacement and consent after config reloads. Extend the PTY integration test to verify startup size buckets, turn-start observations, and delayed resize observations with analytics disabled and an explicit OTLP collector.

prs.title: Refresh model instructions in incremental-tool context windows
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Refresh model instructions in incremental-tool context windows

## Why

Incremental-tool windows recorded base instructions only at setup, so a catalog refresh for the same model could leave active instructions stale. Instruction changes need to reach the model without rewriting the existing history prefix.

## What changed

- Track model identity and instruction content independently, appending a `model_instructions` developer message when either changes. Explicitly mark replacement or removal of base instructions, and avoid repeating unchanged updates.
- Start new windows after compaction with the latest model instructions while preserving custom base instructions.
- Preserve the recorded window base during local compaction retries, including empty instructions, and rebuild current model instructions when reconstructing child context.

## Testing

Add integration tests and request snapshots for catalog refreshes, instruction removal, model switches, compaction, restart, and forks. Extend regression coverage for legacy snapshots and local compaction retries.

prs.title: Preserve running turn recovery across thread settings updates
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve running turn recovery across thread settings updates

## Why

Standalone thread settings updates cleared the running turn's continuation lineage, preventing recovery after a daemon restart.

## What changed

Preserve continuation lineage while a task is registered. Continue invalidating pending continuations for idle, reserved, and finishing turns, and record started-turn lineage atomically with task registration.

## Testing

Extend settings invalidation coverage to idle, reserved, and finishing turns. Exercise an in-flight reasoning effort update before compaction, then verify cold resume preserves the turn's frozen settings and allows continuation. Wait for thread idle before testing idle continuation.

prs.title: Resume unloaded subagent threads when selected in the TUI
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Resume unloaded subagent threads when selected in the TUI

## Why

Persisted subagent threads could be reported as unavailable when selected after unloading, even though their saved history could be restored.

## What changed

Attempt to resume selected threads marked closed, including those with a cached live channel, and restore their transcript through the existing attachment flow.

## Testing

Extend coverage for V1 and V2 subagents to verify saved transcript restoration, the appropriate direct-input behavior, and reattachment when a close notification from the previous runtime is still queued.

prs.title: Isolate daemon package tests to reduce disk contention
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Isolate daemon package tests to reduce disk contention

## Why

Daemon package tests copy full debug CLI packages. Running these I/O-heavy cases alongside other tests can increase shared-disk writeback pressure.

## What changed

- Move package installation and replacement coverage into the `app_server_daemon_package` test binary, sharing daemon fixtures with the lifecycle tests.
- Reserve all nextest test threads for each package test and add an exclusive Bazel target that runs the cases serially on Linux and macOS.
- Hard-link the prepared fixture executable during package setup, while retaining real independent package copies in the installer.

prs.title: Keep the agent dashboard browsable during task removal
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Keep the agent dashboard browsable during task removal

## Why

Archiving or deleting a task blocked dashboard navigation until the server request finished.

## What changed

Keep the dashboard interactive for browsing while archive and delete requests are pending. Hide the affected task immediately and show an inline progress message. Allow selection movement and search while preventing task switching, new tasks, and leaving the dashboard until the request completes.

Preserve the dashboard selection when removing the current task detaches the session.

## Testing

Update archive and delete progress tests and snapshots to cover navigation, resize handling, immediate task hiding, and suppression of task switching and creation while requests are pending.

prs.title: Preserve conversation history when compaction fails
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve conversation history when compaction fails

## Why

Compaction could record partial output before the response completed, leaving failed summaries in conversation history and persisted rollouts.

## What changed

Buffer compaction output until `response.completed` so failed or incomplete attempts leave no partial output in history. Record successful output before the response completion notification, preserving its compaction metadata.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for preserving messages, tool results, and token usage after a disconnected compaction stream, including after restart. Verify incomplete compaction output is excluded from subsequent requests and successful output remains observable and persisted.

prs.title: Bound rollout input for memory extraction
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Bound rollout input for memory extraction

## What changed

Read rollout evidence from newest to oldest for both memory versions, retaining up to 8 MiB of sanitized response items and inter-agent communications, then restore chronological order. Skip malformed records and records larger than 1 MiB, and require valid session metadata in the first record within that limit.

## Testing

Add coverage for the retained byte budget, newest-record ordering, malformed and oversized records, and unsupported session metadata. Extend extraction request tests for both memory versions to verify that evidence after an oversized record reaches the model.

prs.title: Stop rollout reads when the calling task is cancelled
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Stop rollout reads when the calling task is cancelled

## Why

Blocking rollout reads can continue decompressing and scanning history after the calling async task is dropped.

## What changed

Propagate caller cancellation through rollout readers, prefix validation, model-context scans, history materialization, and working-directory lookup. Check cancellation during compressed input and output, bounded reads, seeks, and between history records. Return an error on cancellation so partial history cannot be mistaken for a complete read.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for dropping a caller during decompression, cancelling compressed input and output (including skippable frames), cancelling reads and seeks on plain and decoded snapshots, and cancelling history materialization between records.

prs.title: Test memory extraction budgets with excluded items and ciphertext
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Test memory extraction budgets with excluded items and ciphertext

Extend phase-one request tests for both memory versions with reasoning,
developer messages, and assistant ciphertext whose combined size exceeds
the reader budget while individual records remain below the record limit.
Verify that earlier extraction evidence and assistant text alongside large
ciphertext remain in the request, with `encrypted_content` excluded.

prs.title: Avoid reconnect races in the daemon restart test
Skip service backoff for stale Guardian authorization retries
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Skip service backoff for stale Guardian authorization retries

## Why

Stale authorization requires refreshing local evidence, so service retry backoff unnecessarily delays the next review attempt.

## What changed

Yield cooperatively before retrying `StaleAuthorization`, then check cancellation and the shared deadline. Keep retries within the existing attempt budget.

## Testing

Extend paused-time tests to cover recovery with fresh evidence and exhaustion of the shared attempt budget, asserting that retries incur no backoff and return the final attempt's evidence.

prs.title: Keep host MCP and plugin configuration local with remote environments
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Keep host MCP and plugin configuration local with remote environments

## Why

A remote primary environment could supply its working directory and workspace roots to host plugins and MCP processes, breaking relative MCP executable resolution and applying the wrong workspace permissions.

## What changed

- Build host configuration from the local environment, falling back to the session's host working directory and runtime workspace roots when no local environment is selected. Preserve explicitly empty local roots.
- Use the same host configuration for MCP startup and refresh, and refresh MCP state when runtime workspace roots change.
- Keep repository skill discovery paired with the primary executor's working directory and filesystem.
- Box skill warmup and turn context construction futures to reduce enclosing future sizes.

## Testing

Extend the MCP integration test to cover a remote primary with populated, empty, or absent local roots; relative executable resolution before and after refresh; workspace-root revocation; and remote repository skill discovery.

prs.title: Report the reason for ChatGPT token refresh requests
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Report the reason for ChatGPT token refresh requests

## What changed

Include a `refresh_reason` diagnostic in ChatGPT OAuth token refresh requests to distinguish `proactive_expiry`, `scheduled`, `unauthorized_recovery`, and `forced` refreshes. Omit the field for gateway refresh requests.

## Testing

Extend refresh tests to check the reported reasons, including scheduled refreshes when access token expiry is unavailable.

prs.title: Filter rollout filenames before checking compressed siblings
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Filter rollout filenames before checking compressed siblings

## Why

Filesystem lookups by thread or rollout ID check whether unrelated compressed rollouts have an uncompressed sibling. These checks are unnecessary when the filename does not match the requested ID.

## What changed

Apply the thread or rollout ID filter before resolving plain/compressed file precedence. Preserve preference for uncompressed files and selection of the newest rollout for a thread.

## Testing

Extend lookup tests to cover unrelated compressed files, uncompressed-file precedence, missing rollout IDs, and rollout ID tie-breaking for files with the same timestamp.

prs.title: Include compressed rollouts in doctor storage statistics
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Include compressed rollouts in doctor storage statistics

## Why

Doctor's rollout statistics only counted `.jsonl` files, omitting storage used by compressed `.jsonl.zst` rollouts.

## What changed

Recognize compressed rollouts when collecting active and archived file counts, total bytes, and average bytes. Count both physical files when plain and compressed representations coexist, while continuing to ignore unrelated files and compression temporary files.

## Testing

Extend the rollout statistics test to cover nested plain and compressed files, coexisting representations, archived compressed rollouts, and ignored files, with a snapshot of the reported counts and sizes.

prs.title: Fix session lookup and resume after rollout compression
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix session lookup and resume after rollout compression

## Why

Compression replaces `.jsonl` rollout files with `.jsonl.zst` files, so checking only the original path can skip existing sessions. Compression can also replace a file between path lookup and canonicalization.

## What changed

- Resolve compressed rollout alternatives when selecting the latest local session.
- Retry rollout path resolution when files disappear during lookup or canonicalization.

## Testing

Extend coverage to verify latest-session filtering after startup compression and resuming a compressed rollout through its original relative `.jsonl` path with preserved turns.

prs.title: Preserve Windows startup variables and MXC child environment defaults
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve Windows startup variables and MXC child environment defaults

## Why

Windows MXC needs valid host startup variables, while an empty child environment must remain empty for the SDK to select Windows user-profile defaults.

## What changed

- Replace caller overrides of `SystemDrive` and `LOCALAPPDATA` case-insensitively with nonempty Unicode host values, failing before launch if either is unavailable.
- Track whether the original child environment was empty, ignoring launcher transport keys. Supply host `SystemRoot` for launcher bootstrap in that case, then clear the bootstrap environment before the SDK selects defaults.

## Testing

Extend transport tests to cover host-value replacement and preservation of empty child environments. Strengthen the PowerShell fallback RPC test to require `SystemDrive`, `LOCALAPPDATA`, `USERPROFILE`, and `PATH` in the child.

prs.title: Bound concurrent Git diffs for untracked files
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Bound concurrent Git diffs for untracked files

## Why

Collecting a diff previously launched a Git process for every untracked file at once, allowing process counts to grow with the number of files.

## What changed

Limit untracked-file diffs to eight concurrent operations per collection while preserving patch order and skipping failed file diffs. Concurrent collections each retain their own limit.

## Testing

Add tests for independent concurrency limits, failed-file handling, and patch order and application with tracked changes, binary files, and filenames containing spaces or a leading dash.

prs.title: Extend memory extension resource retention to 14 days
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Extend memory extension resource retention to 14 days

## What changed

Increase memory extension resource retention from 7 to 14 days before pruning.

## Testing

Update pruning and startup test fixtures for the 14-day retention window, including resources at the exact cutoff.

prs.title: Return async Guardian approvals before review cleanup finishes
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Return async Guardian approvals before review cleanup finishes

## Why

An asynchronous approval currently waits for the redundant synchronous review to finish cancellation cleanup before returning a decision.

## What changed

Cancel the redundant review and let it drain under the parent's `ReviewerTasks` tracker so a current approval can return immediately. Revalidate the approval and check cancellation before approving the action. Hosts without a task tracker continue to wait for cleanup.

Keep the reviewer reservation held until cleanup completes, and let shutdown join the tracked attempt. Discard late results and evidence from the cancelled review.

## Testing

Add tests covering current, invalidated, and cancelled approvals while cleanup is blocked, suppression of late evidence, reviewer reservations during cleanup, and shutdown waiting for abandoned attempts.

prs.title: Keep fork lineage ahead of paginated transcript history
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Keep fork lineage ahead of paginated transcript history

## Why

Loading older history could place transcript entries before the `Thread forked from` notice, separating fork lineage from the session header.

## What changed

Treat fork lineage as a session prefix in both the TUI transcript and transcript overlay so older pages are inserted after it.

## Testing

Add regression tests for repeated history prepends in both paths, verifying that fork lineage stays first.

Fix Windows environment handling for remote MCP servers

Remote MCP environment filtering could drop `SystemDrive` and `LocalAppData`. Explicit overrides also need Windows-aware merging to replace inherited variables with differently cased names.

## What changed

- Apply explicit environment overrides through the executor environment policy, while retaining the final overlay for variables excluded by the allowlist.

## Testing

Extend environment-policy tests to cover the additional Windows variables, overrides with differently cased names, and the final overlay used by older executors.
